name: kx-timy-bridge
description: Optional ALGE Timy3 serial bridge for KX-Results. Forked as a child process by kx-server when this folder is present.
_comment: This is the ONLY place in KX-Results with a runtime dependency.
Competitions timed by hand never install it: kx-server checks for
timy-bridge/index.js at startup and skips the whole feature if absent.
